recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the FHIR-49736 source reconciliation by removing the remaining base-profile summary text that could make component sub-elements look mandatory outside Blood Pressure. Any broader cleanup of unrelated vital-signs summary wording should be handled under separate trackers.
issue_request: FHIR-49736 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6 and asked to remove Must Support from Observation.component in the FHIR Vital Signs Base Profile, including component sub-elements, and move that Must Support requirement to the Blood Pressure-specific profile.
initial_application: No prior source commit explicitly named FHIR-49736. The same change family was applied under FHIR-47136: commit 983b8c8cd0 removed actual Observation.component Must Support flags from the base vitalsigns differential and added Blood Pressure-specific component requirements, with later FHIR-47136 follow-up commits refining component.value[x] slicing and constraints.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini and the Observation Vital Signs IG includes both StructureDefinition/vitalsigns and StructureDefinition/bp. The current base vitalsigns differential no longer marks Observation.component or its sub-elements Must Support, and the Blood Pressure profile carries the component Must Support flags. The remaining seed-related defect was that both active base summary extensions still had old component-specific mandatory-requirement paragraphs for component.code, component.valueQuantity/component.dataAbsentReason, and Observation.related.target.
reconciliation: Changed source/observation/structuredefinition-profile-vitalsigns.xml to remove the stale component-specific mandatory paragraphs from both the structuredefinition-summary and profile-summary extensions. The formal base differential and the Blood Pressure profile were left unchanged because they already match the accepted resolution.
source_changes: source/observation/structuredefinition-profile-vitalsigns.xml: removed stale Observation.component mandatory-requirement paragraphs from both summary extensions; no differential constraints were changed.
